post: If you're obsessed with custom garage builds and raw metal vibes, you need to see this. 🏍️✨ I just checked out Zhang Tie Motorcycles, a custom bike workshop in China, and the craftsmanship is mind-blowing! They still do everything by hand—welding and grinding each frame with pure artisan energy. 🔥 No mass production here, just passion. They even hosted US and Euro rider groups in 2024 (with strict safety training before shooting, of course 📸). Would you ride a custom-built beast from China? Drop a 🛠️ if you want a tour!
